Native Salesforce anonymous Apex at matching source and transport API 62.0 and 67.0. Each one-line anonymous wrapper calls the captured TraceProbe.capture method, which invokes TraceLeaf.fail and returns the caught exception's type, message, cause, line number and stack. org.tsv rows 2–29 retain seven non-trigger exception cases on anonymous and named-test routes; message and stack columns are base64 UTF-8, with N denoting null. The exact class sources are retained to preserve lines. Trigger-induced failures were captured separately; this table does not represent them.
